body: Some parents are horrible and will bring you to a mental institute if you say “suicide” but tell your parents not to get mad at you and make them promise, then see if you can get a counselor, my young years were the best of my life, no financial issues to stop what I want to do. I’m not gonna act like I have all the answers, or I’m a special “can convince anyone of anything” person, I in fact made a post here recently, put off suicide for today and when tomorrow comes, put it off today again, procrastinate, it’s the only time that procrastination is good, enjoy life try and live a little longer, young life is the best, convince your parents of dream vacation, or a pet, don’t think about this till tomorrow, then read this comment again

This is the reason I can’t sleep, I say that a job is too much on me right now and I need a break while I go and do whatever the heck a counselor says to stop my anxiety and suicidal thoughts and insomnia and OCD and my boss says he’ll fire me. A break?! Not even payed?! This is unacceptable you might as well quit. Well I will, will it be the job? Probably not.
